subject: MATHEMATICS
purpose: Subject-wide vocabulary for the second completeness dimension. An atomic ask is any obligation a source question places on the learner that can be lost independently of the question itself. These kinds are generic across every topic; a topic never introduces a new kind, it only supplies instances.

SUBPART.loses_silently_when: a compound question is rendered with only its first part

OPTION.loses_silently_when: an option set is truncated, or a later panel covers the last options

PROOF_OBLIGATION.loses_silently_when: a 'prove ... and hence deduce ...' item keeps only the first deduction

PARAMETER_CONDITION.loses_silently_when: a condition such as 'for which values of k' is dropped, turning an underdetermined item into a unique-answer item

UNIT_REQUIREMENT.loses_silently_when: a modelling item loses its 'give your answer in cubic centimetres' clause

JUSTIFICATION.loses_silently_when: a 'give a reason for your answer' clause is dropped and the item becomes recall

CONSTRUCTION_STEP.loses_silently_when: a construction item keeps the figure but loses a required step

COUNTEREXAMPLE_REQUEST.loses_silently_when: a universal claim loses its 'or give a counterexample' branch
